notes: Distinctive surname (Kancharla) plus a specialty-specific URL, so no same-name ambiguity risk. Identity verified on four criteria: (1) NAME + (2) SPECIALTY + (3) BRANCH + (4) CITY are all encoded in one official URL - yashodahospitals.com/doctor/SOMAJIGUDA/MEDICAL-ONCOLOGY/dr-harish-kancharla/ - which exactly matches the input row's hospital (Yashoda Hospitals), branch (Yashoda Hospital Somajiguda) and department (Medical Oncologist and Hemato-Oncologist). Two INDEPENDENT sources agree, which is why the band is High rather than Medium: the yashodahospitals.com official profile, and his own separately-registered professional website drharishkancharla.in whose site title reads 'Consultant Medical Oncologist & Hemato-oncologist' - matching the input specialty verbatim including the less-common 'hemato-oncologist' half. I have deliberately NOT counted the two yashodahospitals.com pages (doctor profile + cancer team page + online-consultation page) as multiple sources; they are one official domain. Further corroboration (not counted toward the band): his own LinkedIn profile lists Yashoda Hospitals as employer; ResearchGate places him in the Department of Medical Oncology at AIIMS New Delhi, matching the DM-from-AIIMS credential on the hospital profile. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED. Neither Yashoda nor his personal site surfaced a contact number or address in any search result, and no summary asserted one, so there was nothing to run an exact-phrase confirmation against - both fields are left blank rather than derived from the hospital domain. Two things for a human to double-check: (a) he owns TWO domains, drharishkancharla.in and drharishkancharla.com; I recorded the .in as personal_website because its title/content matched his stated role most precisely, and parked the .com in other_profiles - a human should confirm which is the live/canonical one; (b) a search summary said he 'also practises at Diya Hospitals in LB Nagar, Hyderabad'. That came from aggregator-level text, not an official page, so it is recorded only as an unverified note in hni_signals and does not affect the Somajiguda branch attribution, which is directly evidenced by the official URL path. Skedoc is recorded as directory_profile but is corroborating-only per the grading rules and was not used to justify the band. owns_clinic set false: he is a hospital-employed consultant and his personal domains are marketing sites, not an independent clinic.
